paragraphs.text: On Monday morning, Mia has school. She wants to see Anna and ask about the dog. Ben can help them look for Anna.
Dad stays home with the dog. ‘Please take care of it,’ Mia says. Dad smiles. ‘Do not worry,’ he says. ‘We are fine here.’ The dog sits by Dad and looks at Mia. She waves to it from the door.
At school, Ben waits by the door. The three friends go to their classroom together. Anna’s chair is empty. Their teacher says Anna is at home today. Mia looks at Sam. How can they find her house?
